drhp.business: The Company is engaged in manufacturing and sale of jute goods, operating as a single business segment (no IND AS-108 segment disclosure applicable). It sells both within India and overseas, with domestic sales supported in part by Government of India foodgrain-related purchases under the JPMA scheme, and exports affected by freight and tariff conditions in the global economy.
drhp.end_markets: India (domestic market)|Exports, including USA|Government of India purchases under the JPMA scheme (foodgrain packaging)
drhp.expansion: During FY26 the Company incurred capital expenditure towards installation of a rooftop Solar Power Plant with a capacity of 2,274.48 kWp, which contributes approximately 12-15 percent of the power requirement. Machineries required for strengthening manufacturing efficiency were also purchased. The Company operated well below its installed capacity during the year due to economic conditions and the raw jute supply scenario, with no new plant/line expansion disclosed.

risks.note: An insufficient raw jute crop during the year created a difficult situation for the jute industry throughout the season; prices started rising from the beginning of the season and the industry witnessed unprecedented levels of raw jute prices, well above the statutory minimum rates, directly affecting the Company's cost base.
risks.risk: Dependence on raw jute crop availability and price volatility

risks.note: The Jute Commissioner imposed raw jute stock limits on the jute industry throughout the season to ensure equitable distribution within the industry and to prevent hoarding by mills and traders, indicating the Company's key input is subject to government-directed allocation during periods of scarcity.
risks.risk: Regulatory rationing of the raw material market

risks.note: The Company does not have any subsidiary, joint venture or associate company as on 31st March 2026, and none became or ceased to be one during the year, meaning all business risk sits within the single standalone entity.
